key_insight: GLOBE turns rank-based feedback into an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors for optimizing product listings in generative search.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a reusable memory architecture for listing-optimization agents, with moderation and harmful-behavior deactivation to support more dependable execution.
method: An Editor applies relevant handbook behaviors to product listings and receives rank-based feedback.
A Reflector proposes behavior updates; a Moderator removes redundant proposals and a Curator commits accepted changes.
Consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated as the handbook evolves across episodes.
evidence_signal: Experiments report gains over monolithic prompt optimization, further improvements and lower downside risk from evolution and moderation, and transfer to unseen product categories.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative results or evaluation-scale details, leaving effect size and robustness across search environments unclear.
paper_title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
